name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 21, after point a – Am 87
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: (ad) Emphasises the importance of European exports of agricultural and wine products for the Union’s trade balance and highlights the impact of recent retaliatory measures on European agricultural products, such as pork; stresses that European producers of wine, spirits, and agricultural products must not become sacrificial lambs in trade actions related to other industrial sectors; calls on the Commission to establish targeted and effective support mechanisms for the sectors affected by these measures and to seek diplomatic avenues to mitigate the impact of these retaliatory measures;
